name: Island Settings
description: Match-wide rules: players, teams, respawn, building, spawn location.

name: Round Settings
description: Per-round overrides such as round time limits and win conditions.

name: End Game
description: Ends the round or game for a player or team when activated.

name: Team Settings & Inventory
description: Team names, colours, starting inventory and team-only rules.

name: Class Designer
description: Defines a loadout class (health, shields, items).

name: Class Selector
description: Switches the player who uses it to a class.

name: Score Manager
description: Awards score to the activating player or team.

name: Elimination Manager
description: Reacts to eliminations, drops items, grants rewards.

name: Timer
description: Countdown or stopwatch with success/failure events.

name: Tracker
description: Counts stats (eliminations, items, anything) toward a goal.

name: Accolades
description: Grants XP accolades to players for achievements.

name: Player Counter
description: Counts players in an area or the whole game and fires events at a threshold.

name: Player Spawn Pad
description: Where players spawn. Use team-specific pads for team modes.

name: Battle Bus
description: Flies the bus across the island; players skydive from it.

name: Reboot Van
description: Reboots eliminated teammates with their reboot card.

name: Checkpoint Pad
description: Sets a player's respawn point when they touch it.

name: Item Granter
description: Grants items to a player (loadouts, rewards, weapon levels).

name: Item Spawner
description: Spawns items in the world on a timer.

name: Item Remover
description: Removes items from a player.

name: Chest & Ammo Spawner
description: Loot chests and ammo boxes placed around POIs.

name: Vending Machine
description: Sells items for gold or materials.

name: Capture Item Spawner
description: Spawns a capturable item such as a flag.

name: Collectible Object
description: A coin/gem players collect for score or currency.

name: Supply Drop Spawner
description: Drops a balloon crate with loot from the sky.

name: Storm Controller
description: A simple shrinking storm.

name: Advanced Storm Controller
description: Fully custom storm driven by Advanced Storm Beacons.

name: Advanced Storm Beacon
description: One storm phase: radius, wait time, shrink time, damage.

name: Capture Area
description: A zone teams capture and hold for points.

name: Mutator Zone
description: Changes rules inside a volume and reports who enters/leaves.

name: Damage Volume
description: Hurts or eliminates anything inside (lava, kill floors, traps).

name: Barrier
description: Invisible or visible wall that can be turned on/off (pre-round cages).

name: Fog Device
description: Atmospheric fog for mood (horror, night).

name: Water Device
description: Swimmable water volumes for lakes and rivers.

name: Trigger
description: Fires when a player steps on it or another device signals it.

name: Button
description: Interactable button (purchases, doors, minigame starts).

name: Conditional Button
description: Button that requires items (keys, gold) to activate.

name: Switch
description: Toggle on/off state for levers.

name: Lock
description: Locks and unlocks doors.

name: Input Trigger
description: Fires when a player presses a chosen input (abilities, menus).

name: Signal Remote Manager
description: Hand-held remote that sends signals.

name: Sequencer
description: Fires a chain of events over time.

name: Relay / Channels
description: Relays and receivers to wire devices together.

name: Teleporter
description: Moves players between points (spawn rooms, spectator boxes).

name: Launch Pad
description: Launches players into the air.

name: Zipline
description: Fast travel between two points.

name: Rift / Rift Point
description: Sends players skydiving from high above.

name: Speed Boost Pad
description: Speeds players up along a course.

name: Bouncer
description: Bounces players up — great for obstacle courses.

name: Prop Mover
description: Moves props back and forth (moving platforms, sweepers).

name: Race Manager
description: Runs a race: laps, positions, finish.

name: Race Checkpoint
description: A gate racers must pass, in order.

name: Vehicle Spawner
description: Spawns cars, boats, quads, etc.

name: Creature Spawner
description: Spawns hostile creatures in waves.

name: Guard Spawner
description: Spawns AI guards that patrol and fight.

name: Wildlife Spawner
description: Spawns animals for survival islands.

name: NPC Spawner
description: Spawns a custom NPC character (shopkeepers, quest givers).

name: Sentry
description: Stationary turret that shoots players.

name: Boss (Guard + Item Granter)
description: A tough guard that drops a mythic/medallion on elimination.

name: Objective
description: Destructible objective for attack/defend.

name: Explosive / Bomb Site
description: Plant and defuse sites for Search & Destroy.

name: Vault (Lock + Keycard)
description: Locked loot room opened with a keycard.

name: HUD Message
description: Shows a message on players' screens.

name: Billboard
description: Text sign in the world (instructions, shop names).

name: Map Indicator
description: Marker/icon on the minimap and full map.

name: Map Controller
description: Captures the minimap for custom islands.

name: Popup Dialog
description: Modal dialog with buttons (tutorials, shops, votes).

name: HUD Controller
description: Shows/hides HUD elements.

name: Leaderboard / Scoreboard
description: Shows top players (uses island stats).

name: Day Sequence
description: Time of day, sun and sky colours.

name: Skydome
description: Sky style and clouds.

name: Post Process
description: Colour grading and effects (horror, retro).

name: Audio Player
description: Plays music or sound effects.

name: Radio
description: Background music for lobbies and hangouts.

name: Cinematic Sequence
description: Plays a Sequencer cinematic (intros, outros).

name: Campfire
description: Heals players nearby.

name: Analytics
description: Counts custom events for your island analytics.

name: Matchmaking Portal
description: Sends players to another island (hubs).

name: Player Reference
description: Shows a player statue (top player, winner).

name: Prop-o-Matic / Prop Manipulator
description: Lets players disguise as props (Prop Hunt).

name: Verse Device (generated)
description: A custom device generated by Island Forge.

name: Down But Not Out
description: Knocked-down state and revives for team modes.

name: Attribute Evaluator
description: Checks a player (team, class, items) and branches.

name: Random Number Generator
description: Picks a random value and fires events.

name: Stat Creator
description: Defines a custom stat (coins, kills, laps).

name: Timed Objective
description: Objective that must be held or defused before time runs out.

name: Skilled Interaction
description: Timing mini-game interaction (lock picking, hacking).

name: XP Coin
description: Collectible coin that awards XP.

name: Player Checkpoint
description: Sets respawn location (Verse-controllable checkpoint).

name: Skydive Volume
description: Lets players skydive / glide inside a volume.

name: Rift Point Volume
description: Teleports players high into the sky to redeploy.

name: Changing Booth
description: Lets players change outfit.

name: Character Device
description: Displays a character model that can emote.

name: Item Placer
description: Places a single item in the world.

name: Health Powerup
description: Pickup that heals.

name: Shield Powerup
description: Pickup that grants shields.

name: Damage Amplifier Powerup
description: Pickup that boosts damage.

name: Visual Effect Powerup
description: Pickup that applies a visual effect.

name: Fishing Zone
description: Water area players can fish in.

name: Fishing Rod Barrel
description: Gives players a fishing rod.

name: Air Vent
description: Blows players upward.

name: Ascender
description: Zip players straight up a rope.

name: Grind Rail
description: Rail players slide along.

name: Movement Modulator
description: Changes player speed (speed pads, slow zones).

name: Trick Tile
description: Floor tile that drops, flips or hides when stepped on.

name: Pinball Bumper
description: Bounces players away.

name: Pinball Flipper
description: Flips players across the map.

name: Physics Boulder
description: Rolling boulder that knocks players down.

name: Physics Tree
description: Tree that falls with physics.

name: Perception Trigger
description: Fires when a player looks at it or is seen.

name: Pulse Trigger
description: Sends a moving pulse that triggers devices in sequence.

name: Color Changing Tiles
description: Tiles that change colour when stepped on (territory games).

name: Player Marker
description: Marks a player on the map/HUD.

name: Chair
description: A seat players can sit on.

name: Sports Car Spawner
description: Spawns a sports car.

name: Sedan Spawner
description: Spawns a sedan.

name: Pickup Truck Spawner
description: Spawns a pickup truck.

name: Semi Truck Spawner
description: Spawns a big rig.

name: Taxi Spawner
description: Spawns a taxi.

name: Quadcrasher Spawner
description: Spawns a Quadcrasher.

name: Baller Spawner
description: Spawns a Baller.

name: Motorboat Spawner
description: Spawns a motorboat.

name: Helicopter Spawner
description: Spawns a helicopter.

name: Dirt Bike Spawner
description: Spawns a dirt bike.

name: Tank Spawner
description: Spawns a tank.

name: UFO Spawner
description: Spawns a UFO.

name: Shopping Cart Spawner
description: Spawns a shopping cart.

name: ATK Spawner
description: Spawns an all-terrain kart.

name: X-4 Stormwing Spawner
description: Spawns a prop plane.

name: Hoverboard Spawner
description: Spawns a hoverboard.

name: Creature Placer
description: Places a single creature.

name: Creature Manager
description: Tunes creature health and damage.

name: Automated Turret
description: Turret that targets players or creatures.

name: AI Patrol Path
description: Path guards walk along.

name: Ball Spawner
description: Spawns a ball for sports modes.

name: Shooting Gallery Target
description: Pop-up target for aim courses.

name: Explosive Barrel
description: Barrel that explodes when shot.

name: Video Player
description: Plays a video on a screen.

name: Holoscreen
description: Floating screen with text or an image.

name: Beacon
description: Light beam / waypoint visible from far away.

name: Orbit Camera
description: Third-person orbit camera for the player.

name: Fixed Point Camera
description: Camera locked to a position (horror, side-scroller).

name: Fixed Angle Camera
description: Top-down / isometric camera.

name: First Person Camera
description: First-person view.

name: Customizable Light
description: Coloured light that can be toggled.

name: Audio Mixer
description: Controls volume buses.

name: Crowd Volume
description: Cheering crowd in stands.

name: Dance Mannequin
description: Mannequin that shows a dance.

name: Fire Device
description: Spreading or static fire.

name: VFX Spawner
description: Particle effects (smoke, sparks, confetti).

name: Note Sequencer
description: Patchwork melody sequencer.

name: Drum Sequencer
description: Patchwork drum sequencer.

name: Instrument Player
description: Plays a Patchwork instrument.

name: Omega Synthesizer
description: Patchwork synthesizer.

name: Speaker
description: Outputs Patchwork audio.
